QuestInfo.name: Unknown Blue Material
QuestInfo.1: Inside the cracked rubble, Dr. Bruce found a strange blue substance. He's curious if all Golems have this substance inside them, so he wants you to bring him 10 Dark Stone Golem Rubbles.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You brought a pile of Dark Stone Golem Rubble for Dr. Bruce to examine. Could they contain the blue substance, as well?

0.0: There was some very interesting blue goo that poured out when I cracked that rubble open. I'm postulating either some sort of nano-virus or a very toxic form of blueberry jam. Or MAYBE it's some kind of ultra secret nano-jam! We'll need to find out if other golems contain the same sort of nano-jam. Go back to the Golem's Temple and bring me 10 Dark Stone Golem Rubbles. No need to be too picky this time. I think I've discovered a way to get these things open without losing the sweet, sweet goo inside.\r\n

yes.0: There should be a gate to get into the Golem's Temple at the lowest section of the Golem's Temple Entrance. Go do your thing and make me 10 Dark Stone Golem Rubbles!

no.0: But, there is science to be done! I knew I should have given this job to that evil robot lady.

1.0: Thank goodness you're back! I tried some of that nano-jam and I think it's starting to eat through the lining of my stomach. If my hypothesis is correct, eating this rubble should help soak up the horrible concoction I just consumed. Hand them over!\r\n

yes.0: #b(Bruce cracks off chunks of rubble and throws them in his mouth.)#k\n Mmf, pay no attention, mmf, to the man doing science, mmf.

item.0: There should be a gate to get into the Golem's Temple at the lowest section of the Golem's Temple Entrance. Go do your thing and make me 10 Dark Stone Golem Rubbles!
